versos.grego: Ἦν δὲ τὸ πάσχα καὶ τὰ ἄζυμα μετὰ δύο ἡμέρας. καὶ ἐζήτουν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς πῶς αὐτὸν ἐν δόλῳ κρατήσαντες ἀποκτείνωσιν.

controles.web: It was now two days before the feast of the Passover and the unleavened bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception, and kill him.
controles.kjv: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.
controles.livre: E dali a dois dias era a Páscoa, e a festa dos pães sem fermento; e os chefes dos sacerdotes, e os escribas buscavam um meio de prendê-lo através de um engano, e o matarem.

versos.grego: ἔλεγον γάρ Μὴ ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ, μή ποτε ἔσται θόρυβος τοῦ λαοῦ.

controles.web: For they said, “Not during the feast, because there might be a riot of the people.”
controles.kjv: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.
controles.livre: Pois diziam: “Não na festa, para que não aconteça tumulto entre o povo.”

versos.grego: Καὶ ὄντος αὐτοῦ ἐν Βηθανίᾳ ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ Σίμωνος τοῦ λεπροῦ, κατακειμένου αὐτοῦ ἦλθεν γυνὴ ἔχουσα ἀλάβαστρον μύρου νάρδου πιστικῆς πολυτελοῦς· συντρίψασα τὴν ἀλάβαστρον κατέχεεν αὐτοῦ τῆς κεφαλῆς.

controles.web: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar, and poured it over his head.
controles.kjv: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.
controles.livre: E estando ele em Betânia, na casa de Simão o Leproso, sentado à mesa , veio uma mulher, que tinha um vaso de alabastro, de óleo perfumado de nardo puro, de muito preço, e quebrando o vaso de alabastro, derramou-o sobre a cabeça dele.

versos.grego: ἦσαν δέ τινες ἀγανακτοῦντες πρὸς ἑαυτούς Εἰς τί ἡ ἀπώλεια αὕτη τοῦ μύρου γέγονεν;

controles.web: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, “Why has this ointment been wasted?
controles.kjv: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?
controles.livre: E houve alguns que em si mesmos se indignaram, e disseram : “Para que foi feito este desperdício do óleo perfumado?

versos.grego: ἠδύνατο γὰρ τοῦτο τὸ μύρον πραθῆναι ἐπάνω δηναρίων τριακοσίων καὶ δοθῆναι τοῖς πτωχοῖς· καὶ ἐνεβριμῶντο αὐτῇ.

controles.web: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii,  and given to the poor.” They grumbled against her.
controles.kjv: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.
controles.livre: Porque este óleo perfumado podia ter sido vendido por mais de trezentos denários, e seria dado aos pobres.” E reclamavam contra ela.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Ἄφετε αὐτήν· τί αὐτῇ κόπους παρέχετε; καλὸν ἔργον ἠργάσατο ἐν ἐμοί.

controles.web: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.
controles.kjv: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.
controles.livre: Porém Jesus disse: “Deixai-a; por que a incomodais? Ela me fez boa obra.

versos.grego: πάντοτε γὰρ τοὺς πτωχοὺς ἔχετε μεθ’ ἑαυτῶν, καὶ ὅταν θέλητε δύνασθε αὐτοῖς εὖ ποιῆσαι, ἐμὲ δὲ οὐ πάντοτε ἔχετε.

controles.web: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.
controles.kjv: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.
controles.livre: Porque pobres sempre tendes convosco; e quando quiserdes, podeis lhes fazer bem; porém a mim, nem sempre me tendes.

versos.grego: ὃ ἔσχεν ἐποίησεν· προέλαβεν μυρίσαι τὸ σῶμά μου εἰς τὸν ἐνταφιασμόν.

controles.web: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.
controles.kjv: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.
controles.livre: Esta fez o que podia; adiantou-se para ungir o meu corpo, para a sepultura.

versos.grego: ἀμὴν δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν, ὅπου ἐὰν κηρυχθῇ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον εἰς ὅλον τὸν κόσμον, καὶ ὃ ἐποίησεν αὕτη λαληθήσεται εἰς μνημόσυνον αὐτῆς.

controles.web: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”
controles.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
controles.livre: Em verdade vos digo, que onde quer que em todo o mundo o Evangelho for pregado, também o que esta fez será dito em sua memória.”

versos.grego: Καὶ Ἰούδας Ἰσκαριὼθ, ὁ εἷς τῶν δώδεκα, ἀπῆλθεν πρὸς τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς ἵνα αὐτὸν παραδοῖ αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.
controles.kjv: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.
controles.livre: E Judas Iscariotes, um dos doze, foi aos chefes dos sacerdotes, para o entregar a eles.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες ἐχάρησαν καὶ ἐπηγγείλαντο αὐτῷ ἀργύριον δοῦναι. καὶ ἐζήτει πῶς αὐτὸν εὐκαίρως παραδοῖ.

controles.web: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.
controles.kjv: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.
controles.livre: E eles ouvindo, alegraram-se; e prometeram lhe dar dinheiro; e buscava como o entregaria em tempo oportuno.

versos.grego: Καὶ τῇ πρώτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν ἀζύμων, ὅτε τὸ πάσχα ἔθυον, λέγουσιν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ Ποῦ θέλεις ἀπελθόντες ἑτοιμάσωμεν ἵνα φάγῃς τὸ πάσχα;

controles.web: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”
controles.kjv: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?
controles.livre: E o primeiro dia dos pães sem fermento, quando sacrificavam o cordeiro da Páscoa, seus discípulos lhe disseram: “Onde queres que vamos preparar para comerdes a Páscoa?”

versos.grego: καὶ ἀποστέλλει δύο τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ὑπάγετε εἰς τὴν πόλιν, καὶ ἀπαντήσει ὑμῖν ἄνθρωπος κεράμιον ὕδατος βαστάζων· ἀκολουθήσατε αὐτῷ,

controles.web: He sent two of his disciples, and said to them, “Go into the city, and there you will meet a man carrying a pitcher of water. Follow him,
controles.kjv: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.
controles.livre: E mandou dois de seus discípulos, e disse-lhes: “Ide à cidade, e um homem que leva um cântaro de água vos encontrará, a ele segui.

versos.grego: καὶ ὅπου ἐὰν εἰσέλθῃ εἴπατε τῷ οἰκοδεσπότῃ ὅτι Ὁ Διδάσκαλος λέγει Ποῦ ἐστιν τὸ κατάλυμά μου, ὅπου τὸ πάσχα μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν μου φάγω;

controles.web: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’
controles.kjv: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
controles.livre: E onde quer que ele entrar, dizei ao senhor da casa: O Mestre diz: Onde está o cômodo onde comerei Páscoa com meus discípulos?

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτὸς ὑμῖν δείξει ἀνάγαιον μέγα ἐστρωμένον ἕτοιμον· καὶ ἐκεῖ ἑτοιμάσατε ἡμῖν.

controles.web: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”
controles.kjv: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.
controles.livre: E ele vos mostrará um grande salão, ornado e preparado; ali fazei os preparativos para nós.”

versos.grego: καὶ ἐξῆλθον οἱ μαθηταὶ καὶ ἦλθον εἰς τὴν πόλιν καὶ εὗρον καθὼς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἡτοίμασαν τὸ πάσχα.

controles.web: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.
controles.kjv: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
controles.livre: E osdiscípulos saíram, e vieram à cidade, e acharam como havia lhes dito, e prepararam a Páscoa.

versos.grego: Καὶ ὀψίας γενομένης ἔρχεται μετὰ τῶν δώδεκα.

controles.web: When it was evening he came with the twelve.
controles.kjv: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.
controles.livre: E chegada a tarde, veio com os doze.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀνακειμένων αὐτῶν καὶ ἐσθιόντων ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι εἷς ἐξ ὑμῶν παραδώσει με, ὁ ἐσθίων μετ’ ἐμοῦ.

controles.web: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”
controles.kjv: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.
controles.livre: E quando se sentaram à mesa , e comeram, Jesus disse: “Em verdade vos digo, que um de vós, que está comendo comigo, me trairá.”

versos.grego: ἤρξαντο λυπεῖσθαι καὶ λέγειν αὐτῷ εἷς κατὰ εἷς Μήτι ἐγώ;

controles.web: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”
controles.kjv: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?
controles.livre: Eles começaram a se entristecer, e a lhe dizer um após outro: “Por acaso sou eu?”

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Εἷς τῶν δώδεκα, ὁ ἐμβαπτόμενος μετ’ ἐμοῦ εἰς τὸ τρύβλιον.

controles.web: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.
controles.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.
controles.livre: Porém ele lhes respondeu: “É um dos doze, o que está molhando a mão comigo no prato.

versos.grego: ὅτι ὁ μὲν Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ὑπάγει καθὼς γέγραπται περὶ αὐτοῦ· οὐαὶ δὲ τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ ἐκείνῳ δι’ οὗ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοται· καλὸν αὐτῷ εἰ οὐκ ἐγεννήθη ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖνος.

controles.web: For the Son of Man goes, even as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”
controles.kjv: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.
controles.livre: Pois em verdade o Filho do homem vai, como está escrito sobre ele; mas ai daquele homem por quem o Filho do homem é traído; bom lhe fosse ao tal homem não haver nascido.”

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐσθιόντων αὐτῶν λαβὼν ἄρτον εὐλογήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς καὶ εἶπεν Λάβετε· τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ σῶμά μου.

controles.web: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed, he broke it, and gave to them, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body.”
controles.kjv: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.
controles.livre: E enquanto eles comiam, Jesus tomou o pão; e bendizendo, partiu-o, deu-lhes, e disse: “Tomai, isto é o meu corpo.”

versos.grego: καὶ λαβὼν ποτήριον εὐχαριστήσας ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἔπιον ἐξ αὐτοῦ πάντες.

controles.web: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.
controles.kjv: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.
controles.livre: E tomando o copo, e dando graças, deu-lhes; e todos beberam dele.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ αἷμά μου τῆς διαθήκης τὸ ἐκχυννόμενον ὑπὲρ πολλῶν.

controles.web: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.
controles.livre: E disse-lhes: “Isto é o meu sangue, o do testamento,  que é derramado por muitos.

versos.grego: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐκέτι οὐ μὴ πίω ἐκ τοῦ γενήματος τῆς ἀμπέλου ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης ὅταν αὐτὸ πίνω καινὸν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it anew in the Kingdom of God.”
controles.kjv: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.
controles.livre: Em verdade vos digo, que não beberei mais do fruto da vide, até aquele dia, quando o beber novo no Reino de Deus.”

versos.grego: Καὶ ὑμνήσαντες ἐξῆλθον εἰς τὸ ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν.

controles.web: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
controles.kjv: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
controles.livre: E depois de cantarem um hino, saíram para o monte das Oliveiras.

versos.grego: Καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι Πάντες σκανδαλισθήσεσθε, ὅτι γέγραπται Πατάξω τὸν ποιμένα, καὶ τὰ πρόβατα διασκορπισθήσονται.

controles.web: Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’
controles.kjv: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhes disse: “Todos vós vos ofendereis;  porque está escrito: Ferirei ao pastor, e as ovelhas serão dispersas.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ μετὰ τὸ ἐγερθῆναί με προάξω ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν.

controles.web: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”
controles.kjv: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.
controles.livre: Mas depois de eu haver ressuscitado, irei adiante de vós para a Galileia.”

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἔφη αὐτῷ Εἰ καὶ πάντες σκανδαλισθήσονται, ἀλλ’ οὐκ ἐγώ.

controles.web: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”
controles.kjv: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.
controles.livre: E Pedro lhe disse: “Ainda que todos se ofendam, porém eu não.”

versos.grego: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀμὴν λέγω σοι ὅτι σὺ σήμερον ταύτῃ τῇ νυκτὶ πρὶν ἢ δὶς ἀλέκτορα φωνῆσαι τρίς με ἀπαρνήσῃ.

controles.web: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you, that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”
controles.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.
controles.livre: Jesus lhe disse: “Em verdade te digo, que hoje, nesta noite, antes que o galo cante duas vezes, me negarás três vezes.”

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἐκπερισσῶς ἐλάλει Ἐὰν δέῃ με συναποθανεῖν σοι, οὐ μή σε ἀπαρνήσομαι. ὡσαύτως δὲ καὶ πάντες ἔλεγον.

controles.web: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.
controles.kjv: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.
controles.livre: Mas Pedro , insistindo, dizia: “Ainda que me seja necessário morrer contigo, em maneira nenhuma te negarei.” E todos diziam também da mesma maneira.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἔρχονται εἰς χωρίον οὗ τὸ ὄνομα Γεθσημανεί, καὶ λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ Καθίσατε ὧδε ἕως προσεύξωμαι.

controles.web: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I pray.”
controles.kjv: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.
controles.livre: E vieram ao lugar, cujo nome era Getsêmani, e disse a seus discípulos: “Sentai-vos aqui, enquanto eu oro.”

versos.grego: καὶ παραλαμβάνει τὸν Πέτρον καὶ τὸν Ἰάκωβον καὶ τὸν Ἰωάνην μετ’ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἤρξατο ἐκθαμβεῖσθαι καὶ ἀδημονεῖν,

controles.web: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.
controles.kjv: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;
controles.livre: E tomou consigo Pedro, Tiago, e João, e começou a ficar muito apavorado e angustiado.

versos.grego: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Περίλυπός ἐστιν ἡ ψυχή μου ἕως θανάτου· μείνατε ὧδε καὶ γρηγορεῖτε.

controles.web: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch.”
controles.kjv: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.
controles.livre: E disse-lhes: “Minha alma totalmente está triste até a morte; ficai-vos aqui, e vigiai.”

versos.grego: καὶ προελθὼν μικρὸν ἔπιπτεν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, καὶ προσηύχετο ἵνα εἰ δυνατόν ἐστιν παρέλθῃ ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ἡ ὥρα,

controles.web: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.
controles.kjv: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
controles.livre: Então ele foi um pouco mais adiante, e prostrou-se em terra. E orou, que se fosse possível, afastasse dele aquela hora.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔλεγεν Ἀββᾶ ὁ Πατήρ, πάντα δυνατά σοι· παρένεγκε τὸ ποτήριον τοῦτο ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ· ἀλλ’ οὐ τί ἐγὼ θέλω ἀλλὰ τί σύ.

controles.web: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”
controles.kjv: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
controles.livre: E disse: “Aba, Pai, todas as coisas te são possíveis; passa de mim este copo; porém não se faça o que eu quero, mas sim o que tu queres .”

versos.grego: καὶ ἔρχεται καὶ εὑρίσκει αὐτοὺς καθεύδοντας, καὶ λέγει τῷ Πέτρῳ Σίμων, καθεύδεις; οὐκ ἴσχυσας μίαν ὥραν γρηγορῆσαι;

controles.web: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?
controles.kjv: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?
controles.livre: Depois veio de volta, e os achou dormindo; e disse a Pedro: “Simão, estás dormindo? Não podes vigiar uma hora?

versos.grego: γρηγορεῖτε καὶ προσεύχεσθε, ἵνα μὴ ἔλθητε εἰς πειρασμόν· τὸ μὲν πνεῦμα πρόθυμον, ἡ δὲ σὰρξ ἀσθενής.

controles.web: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
controles.kjv: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.
controles.livre: Vigiai, e orai, para que não entreis em tentação; o espírito em verdade está pronto, mas a carne é fraca.”

versos.grego: καὶ πάλιν ἀπελθὼν προσηύξατο τὸν αὐτὸν λόγον εἰπών.

controles.web: Again he went away, and prayed, saying the same words.
controles.kjv: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.
controles.livre: E depois que se foi novamente, orou, dizendo as mesmas palavras.

versos.grego: καὶ πάλιν ἐλθὼν εὗρεν αὐτοὺς καθεύδοντας, ἦσαν γὰρ αὐτῶν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ καταβαρυνόμενοι, καὶ οὐκ ᾔδεισαν τί ἀποκριθῶσιν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: Again he returned, and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy, and they didn’t know what to answer him.
controles.kjv: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.
controles.livre: Quando voltou outra vez, achou-os dormindo; porque os olhos deles estavam pesados, e não sabiam o que lhe responder.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔρχεται τὸ τρίτον καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Καθεύδετε τὸ λοιπὸν καὶ ἀναπαύεσθε· ἀπέχει· ἦλθεν ἡ ὥρα, ἰδοὺ παραδίδοται ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου εἰς τὰς χεῖρας τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν.

controles.web: He came the third time, and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
controles.kjv: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
controles.livre: E veio a terceira vez, e disse-lhes: “Ainda estais dormindo e descansando?  Basta, chegada é a hora. Eis que o Filho do homem é entregue em mãos dos pecadores.

versos.grego: ἐγείρεσθε ἄγωμεν· ἰδοὺ ὁ παραδιδούς με ἤγγικεν.

controles.web: Arise, let us be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”
controles.kjv: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
controles.livre: Levantai-vos, vamos; eis que o que me trai está perto.

versos.grego: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος παραγίνεται ὁ Ἰούδας εἷς τῶν δώδεκα, καὶ μετ’ αὐτοῦ ὄχλος μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων παρὰ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ τῶν γραμματέων καὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων.

controles.web: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.
controles.kjv: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
controles.livre: E logo, enquanto ele ainda estava falando, veio Judas, que era um dos doze, e com ele uma multidão, com espadas e bastões, da parte dos chefes dos sacerdotes, dos escribas, dos anciãos.

versos.grego: δεδώκει δὲ ὁ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν σύσσημον αὐτοῖς λέγων Ὃν ἂν φιλήσω αὐτός ἐστιν· κρατήσατε αὐτὸν καὶ ἀπάγετε ἀσφαλῶς.

controles.web: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”
controles.kjv: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.
controles.livre: E o que o traía lhes tinha dado um sinal comum, dizendo: “Ao que eu beijar, é esse; prendei-o, e levai-o em segurança.”

versos.grego: καὶ ἐλθὼν εὐθὺς προσελθὼν αὐτῷ λέγει Ῥαββεί, καὶ κατεφίλησεν αὐτόν·

controles.web: When he had come, immediately he came to him, and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.
controles.kjv: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.
controles.livre: E quando veio, logo foi-se a ele, e disse-lhe: “Rabi”, e o beijou.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ἐπέβαλαν τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῷ καὶ ἐκράτησαν αὐτόν.

controles.web: They laid their hands on him, and seized him.
controles.kjv: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.
controles.livre: Então o agarraram,  e o prenderam.

versos.grego: εἷς δέ τις τῶν παρεστηκότων σπασάμενος τὴν μάχαιραν ἔπαισεν τὸν δοῦλον τοῦ ἀρχιερέως καὶ ἀφεῖλεν αὐτοῦ τὸ ὠτάριον.

controles.web: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
controles.kjv: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
controles.livre: E um dos que estavam ali presentes puxou a espada, feriu o servo do sumo sacerdote, e cortou-lhe a orelha.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ὡς ἐπὶ λῃστὴν ἐξήλθατε μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων συλλαβεῖν με·

controles.web: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?
controles.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?
controles.livre: Jesus começou a lhes dizer: “Viestes me prender com espadas e bastões, como se eu fosse um bandido?

versos.grego: καθ’ ἡμέραν ἤμην πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ διδάσκων, καὶ οὐκ ἐκρατήσατέ με· ἀλλ’ ἵνα πληρωθῶσιν αἱ γραφαί.

controles.web: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”
controles.kjv: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.
controles.livre: Todo dia eu estava convosco no templo, ensinando, e não me prendestes; mas assim se faz para que as Escrituras se cumpram.”

versos.grego: καὶ ἀφέντες αὐτὸν ἔφυγον πάντες.

controles.web: They all left him, and fled.
controles.kjv: And they all forsook him, and fled.
controles.livre: Então todos o deixaram, e fugiram.

versos.grego: Καὶ νεανίσκος τις συνηκολούθει αὐτῷ περιβεβλημένος σινδόνα ἐπὶ γυμνοῦ, καὶ κρατοῦσιν αὐτόν·

controles.web: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself, over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,
controles.kjv: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:
controles.livre: E certo rapaz o seguia, envolto num lençol sobre o corpo nu. E o agarraram.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ καταλιπὼν τὴν σινδόνα γυμνὸς ἔφυγεν.

controles.web: but he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
controles.kjv: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
controles.livre: Mas ele largou o lençol, e fugiu nu.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἀπήγαγον τὸν Ἰησοῦν πρὸς τὸν ἀρχιερέα, καὶ συνέρχονται πάντες οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς.

controles.web: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.
controles.kjv: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
controles.livre: E levaram Jesus ao sumo sacerdote; e ajuntaram-se todos os chefes dos sacerdotes, os anciãos, e os escribas.

versos.grego: καὶ ὁ Πέτρος ἀπὸ μακρόθεν ἠκολούθησεν αὐτῷ ἕως ἔσω εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως, καὶ ἦν συνκαθήμενος μετὰ τῶν ὑπηρετῶν καὶ θερμαινόμενος πρὸς τὸ φῶς.

controles.web: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.
controles.kjv: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.
controles.livre: E Pedro o seguiu de longe até dentro do pátio do sumo sacerdote, e ficou sentado com os oficiais, esquentando-se ao fogo.

versos.grego: Οἱ δὲ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ ὅλον τὸ συνέδριον ἐζήτουν κατὰ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ μαρτυρίαν εἰς τὸ θανατῶσαι αὐτόν, καὶ οὐχ ηὕρισκον·

controles.web: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.
controles.kjv: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.
controles.livre: E os chefes dos sacerdotes, e todo o tribunal buscavam algum testemunho contra Jesus, para o matarem, e não o achavam.

versos.grego: πολλοὶ γὰρ ἐψευδομαρτύρουν κατ’ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἴσαι αἱ μαρτυρίαι οὐκ ἦσαν.

controles.web: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.
controles.kjv: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.
controles.livre: Porque muitos davam falso testemunho contra ele, mas os testemunhos não concordavam entre si.

versos.grego: καί τινες ἀναστάντες ἐψευδομαρτύρουν κατ’ αὐτοῦ λέγοντες

controles.web: Some stood up, and gave false testimony against him, saying,
controles.kjv: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
controles.livre: E alguns se levantavam e davam falso testemunho contra ele, dizendo:

versos.grego: ὅτι Ἡμεῖς ἠκούσαμεν αὐτοῦ λέγοντος ὅτι Ἐγὼ καταλύσω τὸν ναὸν τοῦτον τὸν χειροποίητον καὶ διὰ τριῶν ἡμερῶν ἄλλον ἀχειροποίητον οἰκοδομήσω.

controles.web: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”
controles.kjv: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.
controles.livre: “Nós o ouvimos dizer: Eu derrubarei este templo feito por mãos, e em três dias construirei outro feito não por mãos.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐδὲ οὕτως ἴση ἦν ἡ μαρτυρία αὐτῶν.

controles.web: Even so, their testimony did not agree.
controles.kjv: But neither so did their witness agree together.
controles.livre: E nem assim o testemunho deles era concordante.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀναστὰς ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς εἰς μέσον ἐπηρώτησεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν λέγων Οὐκ ἀποκρίνῃ οὐδέν; τί οὗτοί σου καταμαρτυροῦσιν;

controles.web: The high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”
controles.kjv: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
controles.livre: Então o sumo sacerdote levantou-se no meio, e perguntou a Jesus: “Não respondes nada? O que estes testemunham contra ti?”

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἐσιώπα καὶ οὐκ ἀπεκρίνατο οὐδέν. πάλιν ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς ἐπηρώτα αὐτὸν καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Εὐλογητοῦ;

controles.web: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”
controles.kjv: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?
controles.livre: Mas ele ficou calado, e nada respondeu. O sumo sacerdote voltou a lhe perguntar: “És tu o Cristo, o Filho daquele que é Bendito?”

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Ἐγώ εἰμι, καὶ ὄψεσθε τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκ δεξιῶν καθήμενον τῆς δυνάμεως καὶ ἐρχόμενον μετὰ τῶν νεφελῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.

controles.web: Jesus said, “I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.”
controles.kjv: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
controles.livre: Jesus respondeu: “Eu sou. E vereis o Filho do homem sentado à direita do Poderoso  , e vindo com as nuvens do céu.”

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀρχιερεὺς διαρρήξας τοὺς χιτῶνας αὐτοῦ λέγει Τί ἔτι χρείαν ἔχομεν μαρτύρων;

controles.web: The high priest tore his clothes, and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?
controles.kjv: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?
controles.livre: E o sumo sacerdote, rasgando suas roupas, disse: “Para que mais necessitamos de testemunhas?

versos.grego: ἠκούσατε τῆς βλασφημίας· τί ὑμῖν φαίνεται; οἱ δὲ πάντες κατέκριναν αὐτὸν ἔνοχον εἶναι θανάτου.

controles.web: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.
controles.kjv: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.
controles.livre: Vós ouvistes a blasfêmia. Que vos parece?” E todos o condenaram como culpado de morte.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἤρξαντό τινες ἐμπτύειν αὐτῷ καὶ περικαλύπτειν αὐτοῦ τὸ πρόσωπον καὶ κολαφίζειν αὐτὸν καὶ λέγειν αὐτῷ Προφήτευσον, καὶ οἱ ὑπηρέται ῥαπίσμασιν αὐτὸν ἔλαβον.

controles.web: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.
controles.kjv: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.
controles.livre: E alguns começaram a cuspir nele, e a cobrir o rosto dele; e a dar-lhe de socos, e dizer-lhe: “Profetiza”. E os oficiais o receberam com bofetadas.

versos.grego: Καὶ ὄντος τοῦ Πέτρου κάτω ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ ἔρχεται μία τῶν παιδισκῶν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως,

controles.web: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,
controles.kjv: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:
controles.livre: E, enquanto Pedro estava no pátio abaixo, veio uma das servas do sumo sacerdote.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδοῦσα τὸν Πέτρον θερμαινόμενον ἐμβλέψασα αὐτῷ λέγει Καὶ σὺ μετὰ τοῦ Ναζαρηνοῦ ἦσθα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ.

controles.web: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him, and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”
controles.kjv: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.
controles.livre: Quando ela viu Pedro, que estava sentado esquentando-se, olhou para ele, e disse: “Também tu estavas com Jesus, o Nazareno.”

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἠρνήσατο λέγων Οὔτε οἶδα οὔτε ἐπίσταμαι σὺ τί λέγεις. καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἔξω εἰς τὸ προαύλιον·

controles.web: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know, nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.
controles.kjv: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.
controles.livre: Mas ele negou, dizendo: “Não o conheço, nem sei o que dizes.”; e saiu para o alpendre.

versos.grego: καὶ ἡ παιδίσκη ἰδοῦσα αὐτὸν ἤρξατο πάλιν λέγειν τοῖς παρεστῶσιν ὅτι Οὗτος ἐξ αὐτῶν ἐστιν.

controles.web: The maid saw him, and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”
controles.kjv: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.
controles.livre: A serva o viu, e começou a dizer outra vez aos que ali estavam: “Este é um deles”.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ πάλιν ἠρνεῖτο. καὶ μετὰ μικρὸν πάλιν οἱ παρεστῶτες ἔλεγον τῷ Πέτρῳ Ἀληθῶς ἐξ αὐτῶν εἶ· καὶ γὰρ Γαλιλαῖος εἶ.

controles.web: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”
controles.kjv: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.
controles.livre: Mas ele o negou de novo. E pouco depois, outra vez os que ali estavam disseram a Pedro: “Verdadeiramente tu és um deles; pois também és galileu””.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἤρξατο ἀναθεματίζειν καὶ ὀμνύναι ὅτι Οὐκ οἶδα τὸν ἄνθρωπον τοῦτον ὃν λέγετε.

controles.web: But he began to curse, and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”
controles.kjv: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
controles.livre: Então ele começou a amaldiçoar e a jurar, dizendo : “Não conheço esse homem de quem dizeis.”

versos.grego: καὶ εὐθὺς ἐκ δευτέρου ἀλέκτωρ ἐφώνησεν. καὶ ἀνεμνήσθη ὁ Πέτρος τὸ ῥῆμα ὡς εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι Πρὶν ἀλέκτορα δὶς φωνῆσαι τρίς με ἀπαρνήσῃ· καὶ ἐπιβαλὼν ἔκλαιεν.

controles.web: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the word, how that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.
controles.kjv: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.
controles.livre: Imediatamente o galo cantou a segunda vez. E Pedro se lembrou da palavra que Jesus havia lhe dito: “Antes que o galo cante duas vezes, tu me negarás três vezes.” Então ele retirou-se dali e chorou.
